name: bigdata-skill
description: >- Pulls Bigdata.com (RavenPack) financial and news data via the official bigdata-client SDK and /v1/* REST endpoints — structured financials, prices, analyst estimates, entity-sentiment series, annotated chunk search, screener. Use when the Bigdata MCP's tearsheets/search feel thin and you need the machine-readable substrate: mentions of Bigdata.com, RavenPack, a bd_v2_ key, rp_entity_id, or chunk/query_unit cost.
author: daymade
